title: Travelling and holidays
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató az utazásról, a közlekedésről és a nyaralásaidról kérdez. Válaszolj több mondatban, és mesélj konkrét élményekről is.

questions.q: How do you usually travel around your town?
Do you like using public transport? Why or why not?
Where did you go on holiday last summer?
Do you prefer holidays by the sea or in the mountains? Why?
Have you ever been abroad? Which country did you like most?
What do you usually pack when you go on holiday?
Who plans the holidays in your family?
What is your favourite way to travel: by car, by train or by plane?
followUps: What do you do on long journeys?

questions.q: Which country would you most like to visit one day? Why?

usefulPhrases.en: I usually take the bus / the tram.
We stayed at a campsite / in an apartment.
I'd love to visit ... one day.
I get bored on long journeys.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do you like using public transport? Why or why not?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: It depends. I take the bus to school every day, and it's cheap and quite reliable. But in the morning it's always crowded, so I often have to stand.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Where did you go on holiday last summer?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: We spent a week in Croatia, near Split. We stayed in a small apartment close to the beach.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: We swam a lot, of course, and one day we took a boat trip to an island. In the evenings we walked around the old town and had ice cream.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What is your favourite way to travel: by car, by train or by plane?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I like travelling by train best. You can walk around, read or look out of the window, and you don't have to worry about traffic jams.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Which country would you most like to visit one day? Why?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I'd love to visit Japan, because the culture is so different from ours. I'm really interested in Japanese food, and I'd like to see the cherry blossom in spring.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó mérlegel (It depends … But …), konkrét nyaralási élményt mesél, és minden véleményét megindokolja, így egyik válasz sem marad egyszavas.
Szókincs: az utazás és a közlekedés szavai változatosak (reliable, crowded, took a boat trip, traffic jams, cherry blossom).
Nyelvhelyesség: a múlt nyári élményt következetesen egyszerű múlt írja le (spent, stayed, swam, took), a kívánságot pedig a helyes „I'd love to / I'd like to + igető” szerkezet fejezi ki.
Érdemes megtanulni: „It depends.”, „it's always crowded, so I often have to stand”, „you don't have to worry about traffic jams”, „the culture is so different from ours”.
